subject: Implementation sprint cadence + API interop plan
messages:
From: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>
To: Samir Roy <samir@novagrid.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 7 May 2029 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Implementation sprint cadence + API interop plan

Hi Samir —

Thanks again for a productive kickoff yesterday. Per our discussion, I sketched a concise mutual action plan (MAP) focused on the next 6 weeks to get Novagrid integrated and into a staged pilot. High-level goals: establish API contract and auth flow, complete staging integration, and run a small pilot to validate inference-cost and latency targets.

Key propo sals (short):
- Milestone A (May 13): API contract sign-off (OpenAPI + auth flow). Owner: Ben.
- Milestone B (May 20): Staging integration + end-to-end smoke tests. Owner: Ben + Novagrid Tech.
- Milestone C (May 27): Pilot dataset run + quality/latency checkpoints. Owner: Karthik (SLA config) + Novagrid.
- Cutover window (June 3–4): Production prep and soft cut — contingency rollback plan included. Owner: Olga (release lead).

I've attached a first-pass OpenAPI stub and a MAP worksheet for your team to review. Can you confirm whether the May 13 API sign-off date works for you and who on the Novagrid side will pair with Ben during the contract review?

Also calling out a couple of risk items: 1) tokenization differences that might require prompt normalization; 2) API rate-limit expectations during pilot traffic. We'll propose throttling and prefix-KV caching to keep per-token costs predictable.

If May 13 works, we'll lock milestones and publish a shared calendar invite with twice-weekly 30-minute standups for the sprint window.

Best,
Priya Natarajan
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
attachments: novagrid-openapi-interop-v1.json, MAP-v1.2.xlsx
From: Samir Roy <samir@novagrid.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>
Cc: Novagrid Technical Team <tech@novagrid.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 7 May 2029 11:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Implementation sprint cadence + API interop plan

Thanks Priya — this looks good and aligned. A few notes/questions from our engineers: 

1) May 13 is OK for sign-off but we'd like a 24-hour review buffer after the OpenAPI doc is finalized. Can Ben post the final spec by end-of-day May 10?

2) On auth: Novagrid prefers mTLS for server-to-server calls; do you support mTLS for Private/Dedicated modes or would token-based be required for hosted? We may need a short decision so our infra can allocate cert management.

3) Pilot dataset: we'll provide a sanitized 10k sample by May 22. Is that enough to validate latency/cost?

Owners on our side: Samir (myself) as project lead, and Maya Desai (maya@novagrid.com) as the lead engineer for pairing with Ben.

Couple of asks: share the draft test plan for staging smoke tests and clarify expected load during pilot (TPS targets).

—Samir
Senior Product Manager, Novagrid
From: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>
To: Samir Roy <samir@novagrid.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Olga Petrov <olga@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 7 May 2029 13:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Implementation sprint cadence + API interop plan

Samir — thanks, that helps. Quick responses inline: 

- May 10 final spec: yes — Ben will circulate an updated OpenAPI by COB May 10 to give you the 24-hour review buffer.
- Auth modes: Redwood supports token OAuth for hosted endpoints and mTLS for Dedicated/Private deployments. For the pilot (staging on our shared dev cluster) we can enable token + client-cert optional; for Novagrid's production, if you opt for dedicated capacity we can enable mTLS. I'll loop in our security lead if you want an architecture call.
- Pilot dataset size: 10k sanitized records is fine for perf profiling — we'll plan for 1–5 TPS during pilot ramp and a sustained 10 TPS stress window to exercise batching. Please confirm if that matches your expectations.

Action items after this email: 
- Ben: finalize OpenAPI with example requests/responses and example auth flows (due May 10).
- Maya (Novagrid): pair session with Ben on May 14 to exercise auth and sample calls.
- Karthik: prepare SLA config doc and quality/latency thresholds for May 24 checkpoint.
- Olga: prepare cutover checklist and rollback steps for June 3 window.

I'll create a shared calendar and a short Confluence page with the MAP and test plan links.

Priya
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Maya Desai <maya@novagrid.com>, Samir Roy <samir@novagrid.com>
Cc: Priya Natarajan <priya@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 8 May 2029 08:47:00 -07:00
Subject: OpenAPI draft and pairing session (May 14)

Hi Maya / Samir —

Attached is the OpenAPI draft (novagrid-openapi-interop-v1.json) and a short checklist for the pairing session. Highlights:
- Two endpoints: /generate and /embed. Payloads include model_selection and prompt_options.
- Auth: support for bearer tokens; mTLS snippets added for Dedicated.
- Rate limits: default 50 requests/min per client, with burst handling via queueing — we'll simulate via the staging harness.

Proposed pairing agenda (May 14, 10:00–11:00 PT):
- 10:00: handshake, certificate/token setup (10m)
- 10:10: sample calls + schema validation (20m)
- 10:30: run smoke tests (20m)
- 10:50: recap + next steps (10m)

I've also placed a stub of the test harness in the shared Drive folder. If you prefer a different cadence, tell me and I'll adapt.

Ben Carter
Integration Engineer, Redwood Inference

Subject: Finalized MAP + sprint cadence (confirmed)

Samir / Maya —

Thanks for the quick responses and for confirming owners. This thread confirms the finalized MAP and dates:
- May 10: Ben publishes OpenAPI final spec (done).
- May 14: Pairing session (Ben + Maya) — 10:00 PT (calendar invite sent).
- May 20: Staging integration complete; smoke tests green.
- May 24: SLA & quality checkpoint (Karthik to present thresholds and monitoring hooks).
- May 27: Pilot run completed and initial metrics posted.
- June 3–4: Cutover window (soft cut) — Olga will lead release; rollback plan attached (staging-cutover-checklist.pdf).

Attachments in this message: MAP-v1.2.xlsx (editable MAP with owners/action items), staging-cutover-checklist.pdf, novagrid-openapi-interop-v1.json.

Next steps for each owner: please update the MAP row assigned to you by EOD Friday so we have a single source of truth. I'll also open a short Jira board for visible tasks tied to NG-4721.

If anything changes on your side with the pilot dataset or cert timeline, flag it here — otherwise we'll treat these dates as committed.

Best regards,
Priya Natarajan
